beaches.name: Plage naturiste de Port-Leucate
beaches.summary: The commune's 2025 beach arrêté exempts this naturist zone from its swimwear rule. Article 11 makes swimwear compulsory for all bathers outside the zones specially reserved for naturism and requires decent dress on the beach and in the built-up area. The arrêté lists the 'Plage naturiste' with its own lifeguard post (Poste 5) but does not define the zone's boundaries.
